comment: Device Hub Pro pixel-parity reference. Values are the audited measurements documented in Sources/DeviceHubProApp/ParityMetrics.swift. Coordinates are window points from the capture's top-left (title bar included); the harness scales them by the display's pixels-per-point. 'appearance': 'any' checks are geometry/edge based and should hold in light and dark mode; 'light' checks compare absolute colours and are reported as SKIP when the running app renders dark. See Scripts/README.md.

checks.name: segmented-track-top
checks.description: Inspector segmented control track top: audited 60pt (IN-01), unchanged. (2026-09-28: a plain Picker(.segmented) briefly sat here, centered and content-sized at ~97pt — see segmented-track-left's history — before GlassSegmentedControl restored the full-width track col=1700 sits inside.)

checks.name: segmented-track-bottom
checks.description: Inspector segmented control track bottom edge (IN-01): track top 60 pt + 24 pt height = 84. 2026-09-28: the control is DH's Liquid Glass capsule (NSSegmentedControl, key window), whose soft interior gradient defeats a luminance band-height scan; this reads the bottom rim instead (the white highlight at y=83 that closes the capsule, then the #d5d5d6 edge line at y=84 (the scan stops at the highlight), the same column profile as DH 27.0's own control, compared row by row live).

checks.name: segmented-track-left
checks.description: Inspector segmented track left edge: 9pt side inset from the 1640pt inspector panel edge (IN-01). 2026-09-28: a plain Picker(.segmented) briefly lost this — an NSSegmentedControl with the default .fit segmentDistribution sizes to its segments' content and ignores a surrounding maxWidth:.infinity frame, so two short segments centered at ~97pt instead of spanning the column — until GlassSegmentedControl (an NSViewRepresentable wrapping NSSegmentedControl directly, segmentDistribution = .fillEqually) restored the full-width track: a hand-authored NSViewRepresentable does receive the wider frame maxWidth:.infinity proposes, unlike the built-in Picker bridging, and fillEqually then splits that width between the two segments. Measured 1648.5pt live (`app-IN-01-after-2026-09-28.png`), within tolerance of the audited 1649.
